name: Gallows' End Tavern
summary: Gallows' End Tavern is the principal inn of Brill and the heart of Forsaken hospitality in Tirisfal Glades. Beyond offering shelter and spirits to weary travelers, it serves as an essential hub for class mentors, trade instructors, and covert interrogations.

sections.title: A Gathering Place for the Dead
sections.body: Standing prominently along the road in Brill, Gallows' End Tavern serves as the primary gathering place for newly awakened Forsaken leaving Deathknell and journeying south toward the Undercity. Despite their undead condition, Forsaken still frequent its halls for fellowship, trade, and refuge. The inn houses various class instructors—guiding young warriors, priests, mages, rogues, and warlocks—as well as vendors and medical practitioners.

sections.title: Secrets in the Cellar
sections.body: Beneath the creaking floorboards and tavern laughter lies a far grimmer purpose. Down in the cellars, the Forsaken keep prisoners of war bound and guarded away from public view. Among them are a captured Scarlet Zealot and a Dwarven Mountaineer, held beneath the tavern for interrogation and experimentation as the Forsaken fight to secure their borders against both zealous crusaders and Alliance scouts.

faq.q: Where is the Gallows' End Tavern located?
faq.answer: It is located in the center of Brill, the main Forsaken settlement just north of the Undercity in Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: Why do the undead need an inn or tavern?
faq.answer: While the Forsaken do not require sleep or mortal sustenance to survive, taverns like Gallows' End maintain social bonds and cultural habits from their past lives. It also acts as a secure civic center for training, commerce, and official business.

faq.q: Who is imprisoned in the basement?
faq.answer: In the cellars beneath the tavern, the Forsaken hold captive enemies including a Scarlet Zealot from the hostile Scarlet Crusade and an Alliance Dwarven Mountaineer.

faq.q: What services and trainers can be found here?
faq.answer: The tavern features instructors for warriors, priests, mages, rogues, and warlocks, along with first aid and enchanting trainers, general trade vendors, and an innkeeper.

angles.text: As the first major inn encountered outside Deathknell, Gallows' End Tavern serves as the cultural and functional crossroads for newly awakened Forsaken entering the wider world.
Beneath the taproom floors, the Forsaken keep captured Alliance scouts and Scarlet Crusade zealots detained for intelligence and interrogation.
